# Monoline

> Open-source UI kit: a plain CSS core (@monoline/css) with accessible React components (@monoline/react). Three themes, four accents, no Tailwind, no runtime CSS-in-JS.

Start with AGENTS.md (how to work in this repo) and DESIGN.md (the look and rules). Every component is a folder with source, test, demo and meta.json.

## Accordion (accordion)
Stacked headings that each show or hide a section.
Import: import {Accordion} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Accordion | Status: stable
A11y:
- Each trigger is a button inside a heading with aria-expanded and aria-controls.
- Enter and Space toggle; Arrow keys, Home and End move between triggers.
- single or multiple open items; collapsible lets the last one close.
Files: packages/react/src/components/accordion/accordion.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/accordion/accordion.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/accordion/accordion.tsx, packages/react/src/components/accordion/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/accordion/meta.json

## Alert (alert)
A message that stays on screen, with a title and a tone.
Import: import {Alert} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- danger and warning are role=alert and announced at once; info and success are role=status and polite.
- The title always states the meaning in words; colour is not the only signal.
Files: packages/react/src/components/alert/alert.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/alert/alert.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/alert/alert.tsx, packages/react/src/components/alert/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/alert/meta.json

## Alert dialog (alert-dialog)
A modal that interrupts to confirm a destructive or irreversible action.
Import: import {AlertDialog} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/AlertDialog | Status: stable
A11y:
- role="alertdialog" with a name from the title and a description.
- Focus moves to the Cancel button on open and returns to the trigger on close.
- Escape cancels; focus is trapped; the page behind is inert.
- Clicking the overlay does not close it.
Files: packages/react/src/components/alert-dialog/alert-dialog.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/alert-dialog/alert-dialog.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/alert-dialog/alert-dialog.tsx, packages/react/src/components/alert-dialog/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/alert-dialog/meta.json

## Aspect ratio (aspect-ratio)
Keep media or a placeholder at a fixed width-to-height ratio.
Import: import {AspectRatio} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/AspectRatio | Status: stable
A11y:
- A plain div; the content keeps its own semantics and alt text.
Files: packages/react/src/components/aspect-ratio/aspect-ratio.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/aspect-ratio/aspect-ratio.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/aspect-ratio/aspect-ratio.tsx, packages/react/src/components/aspect-ratio/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/aspect-ratio/meta.json

## Avatar (avatar)
A person or thing as an image with an initials fallback.
Import: import {Avatar} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Avatar | Status: stable
A11y:
- name is required: it is the image alt text and the fallback's accessible name.
- The fallback shows while the image loads or if it fails.
Files: packages/react/src/components/avatar/avatar.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/avatar/avatar.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/avatar/avatar.tsx, packages/react/src/components/avatar/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/avatar/meta.json

## Avatar group (avatar-group)
Overlap several avatars and show how many more there are.
Import: import {AvatarGroup} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- role="group" with an accessible name; the overflow count is plain text.
Files: packages/react/src/components/avatar-group/avatar-group.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/avatar-group/avatar-group.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/avatar-group/avatar-group.tsx, packages/react/src/components/avatar-group/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/avatar-group/meta.json

## Badge (badge)
A short status word or count.
Import: import {Badge} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- Plain text in a span; the word carries the meaning, not the colour.
- For a count that changes, put it inside an aria-live region yourself.
Files: packages/react/src/components/badge/badge.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/badge/badge.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/badge/badge.tsx, packages/react/src/components/badge/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/badge/meta.json

## Breadcrumb (breadcrumb)
The path to the current page.
Import: import {Breadcrumb} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- A nav landmark with an aria-label, containing an ordered list.
- The current page has aria-current=page and is not a link.
Files: packages/react/src/components/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.tsx, packages/react/src/components/breadcrumb/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/breadcrumb/meta.json

## Button (button)
Triggers an action. Native button with solid, line, ghost and danger variants.
Import: import {Button} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Slot | Status: stable
A11y:
- Native <button>: Enter and Space activate, Tab focuses.
- loading sets aria-busy and blocks clicks while keeping the label.
- asChild renders a link without losing link semantics.
Files: packages/react/src/components/button/button.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/button/button.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/button/button.tsx, packages/react/src/components/button/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/button/meta.json

## Button group (button-group)
Join related buttons into one segmented bar.
Import: import {ButtonGroup} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- role="group" with a required accessible name.
Files: packages/react/src/components/button-group/button-group.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/button-group/button-group.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/button-group/button-group.tsx, packages/react/src/components/button-group/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/button-group/meta.json

## Card (card)
A bordered group for one thing you can pick up or open.
Import: import {Card} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Slot | Status: stable
A11y:
- Plain divs and a heading; no roles added.
- With asChild on a link or button the whole card is one keyboard-focusable control.
Files: packages/react/src/components/card/card.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/card/card.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/card/card.tsx, packages/react/src/components/card/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/card/meta.json

## Checkbox (checkbox)
A box to turn one choice on or off, with an indeterminate state.
Import: import {Checkbox} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Checkbox | Status: stable
A11y:
- role=checkbox; Space toggles; Tab focuses.
- indeterminate is exposed as aria-checked=mixed.
- A visible label is clickable; without one, aria-label is required.
Files: packages/react/src/components/checkbox/checkbox.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/checkbox/checkbox.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/checkbox/checkbox.tsx, packages/react/src/components/checkbox/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/checkbox/meta.json

## Code block (code-block)
A block of code with a copy button.
Import: import {CodeBlock} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- The code is a pre/code element; the region has an accessible name.
- The copy button is announced as "Copy code" and confirms with a polite live message.
Files: packages/react/src/components/code-block/code-block.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/code-block/code-block.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/code-block/code-block.tsx, packages/react/src/components/code-block/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/code-block/meta.json

Show or hide one region of content from a trigger.
Import: import {Collapsible} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Collapsible | Status: stable
A11y:
- The trigger is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls.
- Space and Enter toggle it.

## Container (container)
Centre content in a column with a sensible maximum width and side padding.
Import: import {Container} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- A plain div; adds no roles.
Files: packages/react/src/components/container/container.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/container/container.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/container/container.tsx, packages/react/src/components/container/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/container/meta.json

## Dialog (dialog)
A modal window for a question or short task that blocks the page.
Import: import {Dialog} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Dialog | Status: stable
A11y:
- role=dialog with aria-modal; the title names it and the description describes it.
- Focus moves into the dialog, is trapped there, and returns to the trigger on close.
- Escape and the Close button close it; the page behind is inert.
Files: packages/react/src/components/dialog/dialog.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/dialog/dialog.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/dialog/dialog.tsx, packages/react/src/components/dialog/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/dialog/meta.json

## Drawer (drawer)
A panel that slides in from an edge for secondary tasks, details or navigation.
Import: import {Drawer} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Dialog | Status: stable
A11y:
- role="dialog" named by the title.
- Focus is trapped while open and returns to the trigger on close.
- Escape and the overlay close it.
Files: packages/react/src/components/drawer/drawer.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/drawer/drawer.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/drawer/drawer.tsx, packages/react/src/components/drawer/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/drawer/meta.json

## Dropdown menu (dropdown-menu)
A list of actions that opens from a button.
Import: import {DropdownMenu} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/DropdownMenu | Status: stable
A11y:
- role=menu with menuitem, menuitemcheckbox and menuitemradio items.
- Arrow keys move, Enter and Space activate, Escape closes and returns focus, type-ahead jumps to an item.
- The trigger has aria-haspopup and aria-expanded.
Files: packages/react/src/components/dropdown-menu/dropdown-menu.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/dropdown-menu/dropdown-menu.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/dropdown-menu/dropdown-menu.tsx, packages/react/src/components/dropdown-menu/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/dropdown-menu/meta.json

## Empty state (empty-state)
Say that there is nothing here yet and offer the next step.
Import: import {EmptyState} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- Plain heading and text; put the action in children as a button or link.
Files: packages/react/src/components/empty-state/empty-state.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/empty-state/empty-state.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/empty-state/empty-state.tsx, packages/react/src/components/empty-state/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/empty-state/meta.json

## Field (field)
Connects a label, a control, a hint and an error with the right ids and ARIA.
Import: import {Field} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- The label is bound to the control by id, so it has an accessible name.
- Hint and error are linked with aria-describedby; an error sets aria-invalid and is announced via role=alert.
- required sets the native required attribute on the control.
Files: packages/react/src/components/field/field.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/field/field.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/field/field.tsx, packages/react/src/components/field/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/field/meta.json

## Icon button (icon-button)
A square button holding only an icon. The accessible name is required.
Import: import {IconButton} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- Native button; aria-label is required by the type.
- Space and Enter activate it.
Files: packages/react/src/components/icon-button/icon-button.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/icon-button/icon-button.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/icon-button/icon-button.tsx, packages/react/src/components/icon-button/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/icon-button/meta.json

## Input (input)
A single-line text field.
Import: import {Input} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- Native <input>: all keyboard and autofill behaviour is the browser's.
- Inside a Field it is labelled and described automatically; invalid sets aria-invalid.
Files: packages/react/src/components/input/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/input/input.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/input/input.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/input/input.tsx, packages/react/src/components/input/meta.json

## Label (label)
The visible name of a form control.
Import: import {Label} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Label | Status: stable
A11y:
- A real <label>: clicking it focuses the control it names.
- required adds a visual marker; set required on the control for assistive tech.
Files: packages/react/src/components/label/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/label/label.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/label/label.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/label/label.tsx, packages/react/src/components/label/meta.json

## Marquee (marquee)
Scroll a row of items endlessly; pauses on hover and stops for reduced motion.
Import: import {Marquee} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- The duplicate copy is aria-hidden so screen readers read the items once.
- Pauses on hover and focus; animation is off under prefers-reduced-motion.
Files: packages/react/src/components/marquee/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/marquee/marquee.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/marquee/marquee.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/marquee/marquee.tsx, packages/react/src/components/marquee/meta.json

## Number input (number-input)
A numeric field with decrease and increase buttons.
Import: import {NumberInput} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- Native input type="number"; ArrowUp/ArrowDown change the value.
- The step buttons are named "Decrease" and "Increase" and are skipped by Tab.
Files: packages/react/src/components/number-input/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/number-input/meta.json, packages/react/src/components/number-input/number-input.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/number-input/number-input.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/number-input/number-input.tsx

## OTP input (otp-input)
Enter a one-time code, one digit per box, with paste support.
Import: import {OtpInput} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- The boxes are a group with a name; each box is labelled "Digit N of M".
- Typing moves forward, Backspace moves back, arrows move, pasting fills all boxes.
- inputmode="numeric" and autocomplete="one-time-code" for mobile and autofill.
Files: packages/react/src/components/otp-input/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/otp-input/meta.json, packages/react/src/components/otp-input/otp-input.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/otp-input/otp-input.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/otp-input/otp-input.tsx

## Pagination (pagination)
Move between pages of results.
Import: import {Pagination} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- A nav landmark; each page is a button named "Page N" and the current one has aria-current=page.
- Prev and Next are disabled at the ends.
- The gap marker is hidden from assistive tech.
Files: packages/react/src/components/pagination/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/pagination/meta.json, packages/react/src/components/pagination/pagination.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/pagination/pagination.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/pagination/pagination.tsx

## Password input (password-input)
A password field with a show/hide toggle.
Import: import {PasswordInput} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- The toggle is a button with aria-pressed named "Show password".
- The field keeps autocomplete hints so password managers work.
Files: packages/react/src/components/password-input/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/password-input/meta.json, packages/react/src/components/password-input/password-input.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/password-input/password-input.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/password-input/password-input.tsx

## Popover (popover)
A floating panel of content or controls anchored to a button.
Import: import {Popover} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Popover | Status: stable
A11y:
- The trigger has aria-expanded and aria-controls; the panel is role=dialog.
- Focus moves into the panel; Escape or an outside click closes it and focus returns to the trigger.
Files: packages/react/src/components/popover/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/popover/meta.json, packages/react/src/components/popover/popover.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/popover/popover.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/popover/popover.tsx

## Progress (progress)
How far along a task is, or that it is still working.
Import: import {Progress} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Progress | Status: stable
A11y:
- role=progressbar with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin and aria-valuemax.
- Indeterminate omits aria-valuenow.
- aria-label is required.
Files: packages/react/src/components/progress/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/progress/meta.json, packages/react/src/components/progress/progress.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/progress/progress.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/progress/progress.tsx

## Radio group (radio-group)
Pick exactly one option from a short list.
Import: import {RadioGroup} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/RadioGroup | Status: stable
A11y:
- role=radiogroup with role=radio items; one Tab stop for the group.
- Arrow keys move and select; Space selects the focused item.
- Give the group an accessible name with aria-label or aria-labelledby.
Files: packages/react/src/components/radio-group/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/radio-group/meta.json, packages/react/src/components/radio-group/radio-group.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/radio-group/radio-group.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/radio-group/radio-group.tsx

## Rating (rating)
Pick or show a score from 1 to a maximum, as stars.
Import: import {Rating} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- Editable: a radio group (native radios) with arrow-key selection; each star is named "N of M".
- Read-only: role="img" with a text label such as "4 out of 5".
Files: packages/react/src/components/rating/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/rating/meta.json, packages/react/src/components/rating/rating.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/rating/rating.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/rating/rating.tsx

## Scroll area (scroll-area)
A scrollable region with thin, themed scrollbars.
Import: import {ScrollArea} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/ScrollArea | Status: stable
A11y:
- The viewport is focusable (tabindex 0) so keyboard users can scroll it; give it an aria-label when it holds standalone content.
- Native scrolling semantics are preserved.
Files: packages/react/src/components/scroll-area/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/scroll-area/meta.json, packages/react/src/components/scroll-area/scroll-area.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/scroll-area/scroll-area.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/scroll-area/scroll-area.tsx

## Segmented control (segmented-control)
Pick exactly one option from a short row, shown as joined segments.
Import: import {SegmentedControl} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/ToggleGroup | Status: stable
A11y:
- A named radio group; arrow keys move and select, Home and End jump.
- One option is always selected: pressing the active one does nothing.
Files: packages/react/src/components/segmented-control/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/segmented-control/meta.json, packages/react/src/components/segmented-control/segmented-control.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/segmented-control/segmented-control.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/segmented-control/segmented-control.tsx

## Select (select)
Pick one value from a list of five or more options.
Import: import {Select} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Select | Status: stable
A11y:
- Trigger is role=combobox with aria-expanded; the list is role=listbox with option items.
- Arrow keys, Home, End and type-ahead move; Enter selects; Escape closes.
- Inside a Field it is labelled by the Field's label.
Files: packages/react/src/components/select/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/select/meta.json, packages/react/src/components/select/select.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/select/select.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/select/select.tsx

## Separator (separator)
A thin rule between groups.
Import: import {Separator} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Separator | Status: stable
A11y:
- Decorative by default: role=none so screen readers skip it.
- With decorative=false it is role=separator with aria-orientation.
Files: packages/react/src/components/separator/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/separator/meta.json, packages/react/src/components/separator/separator.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/separator/separator.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/separator/separator.tsx

## Skeleton (skeleton)
A still placeholder shaped like the content that is loading.
Import: import {Skeleton} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- aria-hidden: it carries no information.
- Pair with an aria-busy region or a Spinner so loading is announced once.
Files: packages/react/src/components/skeleton/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/skeleton/meta.json, packages/react/src/components/skeleton/skeleton.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/skeleton/skeleton.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/skeleton/skeleton.tsx

## Slider (slider)
Pick a number, or a range, by dragging or with the keyboard.
Import: import {Slider} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Slider | Status: stable
A11y:
- Each thumb is role=slider with aria-valuenow, min and max.
- Arrow keys step; Home and End jump to the ends; PageUp and PageDown take larger steps.
- aria-label is required; a range labels its thumbs minimum and maximum.
Files: packages/react/src/components/slider/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/slider/meta.json, packages/react/src/components/slider/slider.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/slider/slider.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/slider/slider.tsx

## Spinner (spinner)
A small indicator that something is loading.
Import: import {Spinner} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- role=status with an aria-label; polite, not interrupting.
- Animation stops under prefers-reduced-motion.
Files: packages/react/src/components/spinner/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/spinner/meta.json, packages/react/src/components/spinner/spinner.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/spinner/spinner.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/spinner/spinner.tsx

## Switch (switch)
An on/off setting that takes effect immediately.
Import: import {Switch} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Switch | Status: stable
A11y:
- role=switch with aria-checked; Space and Enter toggle.
- A visible label is clickable; without one, aria-label is required.
Files: packages/react/src/components/switch/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/switch/meta.json, packages/react/src/components/switch/switch.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/switch/switch.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/switch/switch.tsx

## Table (table)
Rows and columns of data with a header, in a horizontally scrolling wrapper.
Import: import {Table} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- Native table elements with th scope and an optional caption.
- The scroll wrapper is focusable and named so keyboard users can scroll wide tables.
Files: packages/react/src/components/table/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/table/meta.json, packages/react/src/components/table/table.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/table/table.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/table/table.tsx

## Tabs (tabs)
Switch between related views in the same place.
Import: import {Tabs} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Tabs | Status: stable
A11y:
- role=tablist, tab and tabpanel with aria-selected and aria-controls.
- Arrow keys move between tabs, Home and End jump; only the active tab is a Tab stop.
- Give the list an accessible name with aria-label.
Files: packages/react/src/components/tabs/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/tabs/meta.json, packages/react/src/components/tabs/tabs.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/tabs/tabs.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/tabs/tabs.tsx

A short label, optionally removable.

- The remove control is a real button named "Remove <label>".

## Toggle (toggle)
A button that stays pressed or not.
Import: import {Toggle} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Toggle | Status: stable
A11y:
- A button with aria-pressed; Space and Enter toggle it.
- Icon-only toggles need an aria-label.
Files: packages/react/src/components/toggle/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/toggle/meta.json, packages/react/src/components/toggle/toggle.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/toggle/toggle.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/toggle/toggle.tsx

## Toggle group (toggle-group)
A row of toggles where one or several can be on.
Import: import {ToggleGroup} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/ToggleGroup | Status: stable
A11y:
- single type is role=radiogroup with radio items; multiple type is a group of toggle buttons.
- Arrow keys move focus between items; Space and Enter toggle.
- Give the group an aria-label.
Files: packages/react/src/components/toggle-group/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/toggle-group/meta.json, packages/react/src/components/toggle-group/toggle-group.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/toggle-group/toggle-group.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/toggle-group/toggle-group.tsx

## Tooltip (tooltip)
Short hint text on hover and keyboard focus.
Import: import {Tooltip} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Tooltip | Status: stable
A11y:
- Shows on hover and on keyboard focus; the trigger gets aria-describedby while it is open.
- Escape dismisses it; it stays open while the pointer is over it.
- Never the only place for essential information: touch users do not get hover.
Files: packages/react/src/components/tooltip/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/tooltip/meta.json, packages/react/src/components/tooltip/tooltip.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/tooltip/tooltip.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/tooltip/tooltip.tsx
